nodes.description: Address of the contract owner, set at construction and updated by transferOwnership.
Ownable constructor that assigns owner = msg.sender.
onlyOwner function that changes ownership after checking newOwner != address(0).
External caller address used for ownership, balances, allowance and burn authorization.
SafeMath.mul: checked multiplication with assert(c / a == b).
SafeMath.div: unchecked division a / b.
SafeMath.sub: checked subtraction with assert(b <= a).
SafeMath.add: checked addition with assert(c >= a).
Raw multiplication a * b inside SafeMath.mul guarded by the division assert.
Raw subtraction a - b inside SafeMath.sub guarded by assert(b <= a).
Raw addition c = a + b inside SafeMath.add guarded by assert(c >= a).
Raw division a / b inside SafeMath.div without zero-divisor guard.
Public token name string set in the ERC20Token constructor.
Public token symbol string set in the ERC20Token constructor.
Public token decimals value set in the ERC20Token constructor.
Total token supply, minted to the deployer and reduced by burn.
Mapping of address to token balance, mutated by _transfer and burn.
Nested mapping owner => spender => amount, written by approve and transferFrom.
ERC20Token constructor: stores metadata, mints totalSupply * 10 ** decimals to msg.sender.
Internal transfer routine updating balanceOf with SafeMath and emitting Transfer.
Public transfer of _value from msg.sender to _to via _transfer.
Public allowance-based transfer that decrements allowance[_from][msg.sender] then calls _transfer.
Public approval setting allowance[msg.sender][_spender] = _value and emitting Approval.
Constructor parameter holding the token name.
Constructor parameter holding the token symbol.
Constructor parameter holding the token decimals.
Constructor parameter holding the pre-decimal supply amount.
Source address parameter of _transfer / transferFrom.
Destination address parameter of _transfer / transfer / transferFrom.
Amount parameter of _transfer / transfer / transferFrom.
Spender address parameter of approve.
Sum of sender and receiver balances cached before mutation in _transfer.
Expression _totalSupply * 10 ** decimals in the ERC20Token constructor, unchecked overflow risk.
Omnic constructor forwarding name, symbol, decimals and totalSupply to ERC20Token.
Payable fallback that unconditionally reverts, blocking plain ether transfers.

edges.reason: Ownable constructor writes owner = msg.sender, establishing the privileged account.
msg.sender from the deployer becomes the stored owner address.
onlyOwner modifier compares msg.sender against owner before allowing the call.
ERC20Token constructor mints the whole supply to balanceOf[msg.sender].
transfer moves tokens out of msg.sender's balance.
transferFrom consumes allowance[_from][msg.sender], making the caller the authorized spender.
approve writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender].
burn is onlyOwner and destroys balanceOf[msg.sender].
transferOwnership overwrites the owner state variable with newOwner.
newOwner parameter is written into the owner state variable.
Omnic constructor invokes the ERC20Token base constructor with forwarded arguments.
Omnic inherits Ownable, so the Ownable constructor executes in the deployment chain.
SafeMath.mul performs the raw multiplication a * b validated by assert(c / a == b).
SafeMath.div performs the raw division a / b with no zero-divisor guard.
SafeMath.sub performs the raw subtraction a - b validated by assert(b <= a).
SafeMath.add performs the raw addition c = a + b validated by assert(c >= a).
Constructor computes totalSupply = _totalSupply * 10 ** decimals in an unchecked expression.
_totalSupply parameter feeds the unchecked supply multiplication.
_totalSupply parameter determines the stored totalSupply value.
ERC20Token constructor initializes the totalSupply state variable.
_name parameter is stored into the name state variable.
_symbol parameter is stored into the symbol state variable.
_decimals parameter is stored into the decimals state variable.
transfer delegates the balance mutation to the internal _transfer routine.
transferFrom delegates the balance mutation to the internal _transfer routine.
_from parameter selects the balance debited inside _transfer.
_to parameter selects the balance credited inside _transfer.
_value parameter is the amount debited and credited inside _transfer.
_value parameter is forwarded by transfer into _transfer.
_value parameter is forwarded by transferFrom into allowance math and _transfer.
_from parameter keys the allowance lookup in transferFrom.
_to parameter is forwarded by transferFrom into _transfer.
_transfer reads and writes the balanceOf mapping for both parties.
_transfer uses SafeMath.sub to debit the sender balance safely.
_transfer uses SafeMath.add to credit the receiver balance safely.
_transfer stores the pre-transfer balance sum in the previousBalances local variable.
transferFrom decrements the allowance mapping with SafeMath.sub.
approve writes the allowance mapping for the caller and spender pair.
_spender parameter is the allowance key set by approve.
burn reads and decrements balanceOf[msg.sender].
burn reduces the totalSupply state variable.
burn relies on SafeMath.sub for both balance and supply reductions.
_value_burn parameter specifies how many tokens are destroyed.
Local variable c holds the checked multiplication result inside SafeMath.mul.

normalization_plan.reason: _name is a constructor parameter consumed only by the ERC20Token constructor and can be folded into it.
_symbol is a constructor parameter consumed only by the ERC20Token constructor and can be folded into it.
_decimals is a constructor parameter consumed only by the ERC20Token constructor and can be folded into it.
_totalSupply feeds the unchecked supply multiplication, which is the arithmetic unsafe operation it belongs to.
_from is a temporary alias for the sender address handled inside _transfer.
_to is a temporary alias for the receiver address handled inside _transfer.
_value is a temporary alias for the transferred amount handled inside _transfer.
_spender is a temporary alias for the approval target used only by approve.
previousBalances is a purely local invariant cache inside _transfer.
_value_burn is a temporary alias for the burned amount used only by burn.
c is a local intermediate result of the checked multiplication inside SafeMath.mul.
newOwner is a temporary alias for the incoming owner used only by transferOwnership.
